title: against-sterile-design
summary: Why every modern website looks like a Linear clone with purple neon blobs, and how to bring back genuine human taste.

children.text: Open five developer portfolios right now. You will see: dark background #09090b, 1px border #27272a, a radial blur gradient in purple and cyan, and a hero headline saying: 'Crafting digital experiences at the intersection of design and engineering.'
It is not that this aesthetic is bad; it is that it has become the default corporate beige of the 2020s. When everything is polished by the exact same AI prompt, nothing stands out.

Show your messy whiteboard sketches. Write in the first person. Explain the mistakes you made on your last deploy. Make something with personality, even if it has an imperfect edge. People remember characters, not templates.
